svg.title: Vooya — WebAssembly in your existing web app
svg.desc: At build time, Vite and experimental Rspack or webpack integrations connect to Vooya's Rust provider and native Cargo, rustc, and wasm-bindgen toolchain. Generated WASM and JavaScript run in the browser through Vue, React, or experimental Solid and Svelte adapters. Go/TinyGo, C, C++, and Zig providers are planned. Ellipses indicate additional future integrations. Vooya supplies build integration, types, diagnostics, bindings, lifecycle, and state.

g.text: WebAssembly in your existing web app
